name: town-map
effect: Displays a map of the region including the trainer’s position, location names, visited towns, gym locations, and where the trainer has been walking recently.
short_effect: Use to see the overworld map.

flavor_text.black-white: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.
flavor_text.black-2-white-2: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.
